source_title: 'Cult' X review: Vishwak Sen receives praise for action and direction
source_excerpt: Vishwak Sen has returned to the director's chair with 'Cult', a film in which he also plays the lead character. Touted as India's first slasher film, the project has reached theaters and begun attracting reactions from moviegoers. Early responses on social media suggest that the film made an impression through its action sequences and presentation. However, opinions about the first half remain divided.Vishwak Sen's entry and action sequences receive appreciationOne viewer shared a positive assessment of the opening half, highlighting the staging of the action blocks and Vishwak Sen's screen presence. The post also praised the music and described the film as a decent theatrical experience for action enthusiasts. However, the viewer felt that the second half would be crucial to determining the overall impact."CULT First Half REVIEW #Cult first Half with some well-staged action blocks and solid moments throughout. Overall, a decent watch with enough moments to keep you engaged. , especially to action lovers. Second Half is the key. @VishwakSenActor."Another viewer finds the first half predictableNot all early reactions have been encouraging. One social media user expressed disappointment with the film's opening portion, describing the setup as flat and predictable. The viewer wrote,"#CULT First Half - FLAT!! Nothing exciting, nothing interesting!! A FLAT and PREDICTABLE setup!! The action has just begun. Hoping for a BETTER and more exciting SECOND HALF!!"'Cult' described as directionless funAnother viewer offered a short reaction after watching the first half. The post described the experience as entertaining in parts but questioned the film's narrative direction. The X review read, "halfway through #CULT a very directionless fun."High-intensity action becomes a talking pointThe film's violent action sequences have particularly caught the attention of viewers who enjoyed the first half. One post described the action blocks as wild and engaging. It also singled out Vishwak Sen's introduction and the music as elements that added to the viewing experience."#CULT First Half: YOU ARE NOT READY FOR THE VIOLENCE! Some absolutely WILD action blocks that keep you hooked. Vishwak's entry and the music add to the experience."Vishwak Sen's filmmaking receives praiseAnother positive response focused on the film's concept, action choreography and interval sequence. The viewer also appreciated the background score and Vishwak Sen's execution as a filmmaker."#Cult delivers an engaging and impressive first half with a unique concept, high-octane action sequences and a powerful interval block.
